findings.description: The CMK used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation (defaults to false), so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise and violates common cryptographic key management requirements.

findings.issue_category: No key policy defined (implicit account-wide access)
findings.description: No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire root account (and thus any IAM principal permitted via IAM policies) full control of the key. This provides no least-privilege restriction on who can use or administer the key protecting log data.
